evidence.title: Robustness of Anomaly Detection Models for Industrial Control Systems under Training-Time Data Contamination

summary: Researchers examined the impact of deliberately poisoned training data on anomaly‑detection algorithms used in industrial control systems, testing multiple models under realistic contamination scenarios. The findings reveal that while some detection methods retain high accuracy, others suffer severe performance drops, underscoring the importance of designing more resilient training pipelines.
title: Study Evaluates Robustness of Anomaly Detection Models for Industrial Control Systems Against Training‑Time Data Contamination
